title: Launcher reports a filtered node --test run as passed and eligible when only the file wrapper executed and zero named tests matched
outcome: A focused launcher run of `node --test` with a name filter (--test-name-pattern or similar) is not classified as passed or eligible when no named test case executed: for example, when the target file is a registration-only module and Node counts only its file wrapper. The results say that zero named tests ran, with a distinct classification, as the cargo path already does for zero selected tests.
acceptance: Launcher reports a filtered node --test run as passed and eligible when only the file wrapper executed and zero named tests matched is done
